nl.bodyHtml:
Deze handleiding gaat over Migratiepad wanneer het CMS of framework veroudert. Je werkt in CMS/theme of frontend op staging, met focus op migratiepad, wanneer, cms — niet op losse sidequests in andere menu’s.

Voorbereiding

  • Toegang tot CMS/theme of frontend op staging
  • Focus van dit artikel: migratiepad, wanneer, cms
  • Notitie van de huidige instelling/status

Stappen

  1. Open CMS/theme of frontend op staging en zoek specifiek naar instellingen rond migratiepad, wanneer, cms.
  2. Werk op staging met backup; open theme/builder/code voor migratiepad.
  3. Bouw of pas aan volgens “Migratiepad wanneer het CMS of framework veroudert” met focus op wanneer.
  4. Check responsive, contrast en zware assets.
  5. Deploy, purge cache, spot-check desktop + mobiel.
  6. Documenteer wat je wijzigde rond migratiepad, wanneer, cms (oude → nieuwe waarde) voor support.

en.bodyHtml:
This guide covers Migratiepad when the CMS or framework veroudert. You work in CMS/theme or frontend on staging, focusing on migratiepad, cms, framework — not unrelated side quests in other menus.

Preparation

  • Access to CMS/theme or frontend on staging
  • Focus of this article: migratiepad, cms, framework
  • Note of the current setting/status

Steps

  1. Open CMS/theme or frontend on staging and look specifically for settings around migratiepad, cms, framework.
  2. Work on staging with a backup; open theme/builder/code for migratiepad.
  3. Build or adjust per “Migratiepad when the CMS or framework veroudert” with focus on cms.
  4. Check responsive layout, contrast and heavy assets.
  5. Deploy, purge cache, spot-check desktop + mobile.
  6. Document what you changed around migratiepad, cms, framework (old → new value) for support.

Verify

  • Result for migratiepad, cms, framework matches “Migratiepad when the CMS or framework veroudert”
  • No regression on a critical flow beside migratiepad cms framework
  • External test or second browser/network confirms the result

Tip: Work in small steps: get migratiepad, cms, framework right first, then optional extras.

Note: Do not blindly change production without a backup if migratiepad, cms, framework touches login, DNS, mail or payments.

Still stuck? Open a ticket with TripleZero iT via the client panel. Include your domain name, what you already tried, and any exact error messages (text or screenshot).
